integrity: The displayed infinite-domain formula is supported by a self-contained proof. Finite enumerations are supplementary; no independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite rook graphs and open-neighborhood proper conflict-free coloring; it does not address list colorings. The four-cycle subcase is previously known. Complete bibliographic priority is unresolved because potentially relevant full texts remained inaccessible.
title: The two-color gap in proper conflict-free colorings of square rook graphs
